page_title: Todoist | A To-Do List to Organize Your Work & Life

summary.name: Todoist
summary.one_liner: Todoist is a to-do list and task management app for capturing, organizing, scheduling and sharing tasks for personal and team use.
use_cases: capture tasks quickly with natural language
plan and schedule the week in calendar view
share and assign tasks across a team
run a classroom, clinic or hiring pipeline with task templates
turn scattered tasks into action plans
summary.what_it_does: Todoist lets users add tasks by typing in natural language and organize them into Today, Upcoming, or custom filtered views. Users can set due dates, view their week in a calendar, and create recurring tasks. Teams get a shared workspace for tasks that is kept separate from personal projects, and the page says it works with tools teams already use. The page offers 50+ ready-made templates, such as course checklists and hiring pipeline boards. It also mentions Todoist Assist, an AI feature that turns scattered tasks into action plans.
notable: Shared team workspace separate from personal tasks
caveats: Pro users are mentioned as a paid tier, but the page does not give prices or plan details
Team and advanced features are not fully described on the page
